node.title: Clean-endpoint marked-row split-Veronese dependency
node.closure: exact marked-row elimination and source combination
node.statement: Subtracting x_0 times each unshifted Hankel frame from its shifted frame removes the unique deficient row. A Vandermonde-radical argument excludes marked generic support sizes rho and rho+1; column-farness and a generic combination of the two source relations therefore give a full-support dependence sum lambda_x v_x v_x^T=0 on a set U of at least rho+2=4m+1 domain points. Every x in U is saturated, so v_x is the coefficient vector of a squarefree degree-m locator split on the supported slopes. Equivalently sum lambda_x Q(z;x)Q(w;x)=0, with no residual factor or deficient row remaining.
